+def _feasible_radii(centers):
+    """Given fixed centers, compute the largest feasible radii by repeated
+    passes that set each r_i to the largest value allowed by the wall and
+    its neighbors."""
+    n = len(centers)
+    r = [min(1.0 - math.hypot(x, y), 1.0) for x, y in centers]
+    for _ in range(200):
+        changed = False
+        for i in range(n):
+            ri = 1.0 - math.hypot(centers[i][0], centers[i][1])
+            for j in range(n):
+                if j != i:
+                    d = math.hypot(centers[i][0] - centers[j][0],
+                                   centers[i][1] - centers[j][1])
+                    limit = d - r[j]
+                    if limit < ri:
+                        ri = limit
+            if ri < r[i] - 1e-15 or ri > r[i] + 1e-15:
+                r[i] = max(0.0, ri)
+                changed = True
+        if not changed:
+            break
+    return r
+
+def _local_search(centers, n, iters=300, step=0.01):
+    """Perturb centers and recompute feasible radii to maximize sum of radii."""
+    best = _feasible_radii(centers)
+    best_sum = sum(best)
+    best_centers = list(centers)
+    for _ in range(iters):
+        i = random.randrange(n)
+        dx = random.uniform(-step, step)
+        dy = random.uniform(-step, step)
+        trial = list(centers)
+        trial[i] = (trial[i][0] + dx, trial[i][1] + dy)
+        # keep inside unit circle
+        d = math.hypot(trial[i][0], trial[i][1])
+        if d > 1.0:
+            trial[i] = (trial[i][0] / d, trial[i][1] / d)
+        trial_r = _feasible_radii(trial)
+        s = sum(trial_r)
+        if s > best_sum + 1e-12:
+            best_sum = s
+            best = trial_r
+            best_centers = trial
+    return best_centers, best, best_sum
